task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.
